scenes.spoken_script: They thought you wouldn't notice. Ballard, George A shows up on two public paychecks in Gibson County — $90K combined — on the official record.
The county's own public servers show something that doesn't match how normal budgets look.

Same vendor, same dollar amount, same day — twice. Either accounting duplicated a row, or someone got paid double. The fix is matching invoice numbers on the record. The flagged line: Ballard, George A appears on 2 compensation lines totaling $90,440: Director ($20,000), Chief Deputy ($70,440). Could be innocent — but it's public money and the explanation should be on the record.
